item.title: The Four Levels of Speech — Parā, Paśyantī, Madhyamā, Vaikharī
item.description: How the Ṛgveda, the Pāṇinīya Śikṣā, Bhartṛhari's Vākyapadīya and the Śaiva–Śākta tradition describe the four stages of Vāk — from unmanifest Parā to spoken Vaikharī — and why it matters for mantra and Jyotiṣa.
